## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and does not overwrite unrelated work.
- [ ] Tests cover changed behaviour, including meaningful failure or boundary cases.
- [ ] User-facing documentation and `CHANGELOG.md` are updated when needed.
- [ ] No credential, token, private URL, personal path, full private playlist, personal data, log, generated dependency directory, or build artifact is committed.
- [ ] New dependencies and third-party material have an identified source, purpose, and compatible licence.
- [ ] Security, privacy, compatibility, and release effects are explained.
- [ ] Crow brand assets are unchanged, or Crow’s explicit approval is documented.
- [ ] I have the right to submit this contribution under `AGPL-3.0-only`.
